scientific_integrity: Exact theorem proved by analytic likelihood and probability arguments; independent external audit not performed. Finite checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three conditionally independent symmetric binary signals, equal prior and known deterministic efforts in (0,1/2).
Sincere voting is assumed, not derived in a strategic transfer equilibrium.
Bayesian benchmark may not be implementable with the same institutional observations.
The sharp loss is a supremum, not a maximum; no claim for four or more delegates, correlated reports or unequal priors.
title: Sharp three-delegate Bayesian accuracy loss under effort-proportional voting
